acceptance: Iceberg merge does not load the full target table into pandas.
Spark maintenance enables Arrow conversion or passes Arrow directly.
Post-maintenance table contents match current behavior.
description: platforms/dataframe/iceberg_maintenance.py:289-297 (update) converts matching rows to pandas and back; :322-345 (merge) scans the entire target table to pandas and merges with .map(dict(zip(...))). hudi_maintenance.py:79,87 and pyspark_maintenance.py:123 call spark.createDataFrame(arrow.to_pandas()), row-wise unless Arrow is enabled. platforms/datafusion.py:66-74 DataFusionCursorCompat._materialize builds a tuple per row via to_pylist; maintenance, write primitives and power/throughput fallback fetchall use it. Use pyiceberg upsert/overwrite with Arrow filters, Arrow-enabled or direct Arrow createDataFrame on Spark 4, and an Arrow-native count/fetch in the DataFusion cursor.
